# tappStudio

> tappStudio is an independent app studio in Mumbai, India, run by Ibrahim Broachwala. It designs, builds, publishes and maintains its own iOS, Android and web apps, made for family, friends, faith and community.

tappStudio is a one-person studio. Every app is designed, engineered, shipped to the App Store and Google Play (or the web) and supported in-house, and it keeps getting updates after launch. Apps are built with Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding agent) inside the studio's own code guides, with every design decision and line of code reviewed by Ibrahim. The site at https://tappstudio.in/ is the studio's home: it showcases each app, keeps a public "now" status board of what is live and in progress, and has a contact form (reaching tappstudio.in@gmail.com) for app feedback, bug reports, feature ideas and press.

## Apps

- [Nasab](https://nasab.tappstudio.in): A living family archive app. Build a family tree, preserve family stories, photos, and voice notes, and invite family members to keep it growing together. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nasab-the-family-archive/id6793519541. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.nasab
- [Splitup](https://splitup.tappstudio.in): A group expense and bill-splitting app: split costs, add expenses by voice, work offline, send reminders, and settle up with friends. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/splitup-group-expense/id6744556329. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.splitup
- [My Deen](https://tappstudio.in/mydeen/): A smart Amal (deed) tracker that helps Muslims stay consistent with daily and weekly spiritual habits, tracking Namaz, Duas, and good deeds with reminders, streaks, and achievement badges. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-deen-build-consistency/id6739484125. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.mydeen
- [Misbaha Tasbih Counter](https://tappstudio.in/#misbaha-tasbih-counter): A premium tasbih (dhikr) counter with interactive 3D beads, for a focused, tactile count of daily tasbeeh and remembrance. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/misbaha-tasbih-counter/id6757333557. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.mytasbih
- [Hunar Circle](https://hunarcircle.com): A free, verified web directory of skilled Dawoodi Bohra individuals and their businesses. Browse by craft, city and availability and contact people directly; includes member accounts, admin verification and shareable profile cards.
